llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad website-creation trigger could route general website requests toward B12, but it is consistent with a B12 website generator and does not create hidden or privileged behavior.
[SQP-2] expected: Embedding the user-provided description in the signup URL is central to the skill's function, though the artifact should better disclose the third-party URL privacy implication.
llm.guidance: Before using this skill, understand that the business or project description will be included in a B12 signup link and may be sent to B12 if opened. Do not include confidential plans, customer data, credentials, or other sensitive information in the description.
llm.summary: This skill is a simple B12 website signup helper, but users should avoid putting sensitive details in the generated signup link.
